maya: quick question — found a small off-by-one fix in tokenizer that's consumer-visible only in rare inputs. intended change: no API changes. thinking bump patch v1.8.2 -> v1.8.3. any objections to pinning to patch vs create buildmeta tag?
pranav: patch seems right to me. only behavioral if you hit that input. release notes: 'tokenizer: fix off-by-one in whitespace handling'.
elena: agreed patch. prefer not to change lockfile or semver semantics. if we use buildmeta, ops might skip it.
owen: fwiw, deploy window is open now. but question: do we pin or allow rollforward? if someone pins to v1.8.2 explicitly, will they miss fix? we should document rollback policy.
pranav: customers pin exact versions rarely. internal services use ^ ranges. for dedicated infra we still recommend pinned sha. for patch we should avoid breaking API.
maya: idea: tag release as `v1.8.3` and push release notes. also create lightweight `v1.8.3+build.1` not needed.
deploy-bot: deploy started for refs: `refs/tags/v1.8.3` -> env: staging
sre-oncall: monitoring: I'll watch tail for 10m then promote. set rollback window to 30m.
elena: quick ops question — if a rollback happens, do we publish a patched patch (v1.8.4) or revert to v1.8.2? prefer to patch forward.
owen: patch forward is our standard. revert only if regression can't be patched quickly.
maya: ok plan: v1.8.3 patch bump, rollforward policy, release note, changelog entry, don't touch buildmeta. I'll make PR for release notes and tag.
pranav: SGTM. small nit: mention that this change is non-breaking in release description.
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: `v1.8.3` (build 924f1a). promote? :rocket:
maya: promoting to canary now.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `v1.8.3` -> canary pool
sre-oncall: no errors in canary at +12m. :thumbsup:
maya: rolling to prod in 5.
pranav: thanks. will update internal docs about pinning guidance: prefer caret for libs, exact pins for infra endpoints.
elena: tiny follow-up: add a line in release notes about how we handle rollback (patch-forward).
maya: done — PR merged. closing thread.
